about: Labelled (part, Amazon listing) pairs from audits and the validation set. core/test/match-corpus.test.ts grades every pair with the matcher (grade over wantedFor, as a scan grades a search row): a pair labelled not-part must never grade probable or better, a pair labelled part must grade at least review; uncertain pairs wait for a person. A pair marked known fails today for the reason given and must keep failing until its fix lands, when the mark is removed. One pair per part and ASIN. Written by npm run audit -- score and seed-validation (docs/audit.md).
